judged_text: update passes the unchecked result of EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first into save_host, so an unknown or stale id makes save_host execute nil.host= and crash with NoMethodError, returning a 500 where the REST contract requires a 404. Saving a host that was deleted in another admin tab (or PUTting any nonexistent id) returns a raw 500 instead of 404; the client's popupAjaxError then shows a generic server error that misdirects debugging.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and immediately calls `save_host(host)`. `save_host` unconditionally dereferences `host` (`host.host = ...`, `host.category_id = ...`), so a nonexistent/stale `:id` will pass `nil` and raise `NoMethodError`, producing a 500. The same nil-deref issue also exists in `#destroy` (`host.destroy` without a nil check).
